title: Felix and the Deadline
author: Kestrel Thackeray
blurb: Odile Lockridge, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the summit convenes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
